claims: Q H=sum_i a_i(1-p_i)ln(1-p_i); D=-QH<=abar=sum_i a_i p_i; H=-sum p_i ln p_i.
endpoints: p_i=1: rate=0, do not evaluate deleted posterior or ln0; a_i=0 contributes exact0.
generator: p drift p_i(a_i-abar), mass-tilted deletion rate a_i(1-p_i), deletion normalisation p_j/(1-p_i). This is not raw clock generator.
log_certificate: 100-term atanh series after exact power-of-2 range reduction, rational positive tail, signed ln2 reduction, outward dyadic256. Exact symbolic logp coefficients cancelled before interval evaluation.
product_source: N=n^n unit-total-mass atoms at d*k, k in {0,...,n-1}^n, d=1/(8n), a=1,b=2, receiver0; half-open grid side d, exact cell labels k.
run_policy: Freeze registration and code before one new execution.
save: All posterior p/rates, symbolic coefficients/deletion records, entropy/D/residual intervals in deterministic gzip; complete compressed product coordinate geometry and n ln n intervals.
scope: Only new finite arithmetic and compressed geometry guard. No old max, nearmax or geom closure; no large N enumeration.
subset_rule: Every nonempty subset in integer mask order; keep original labels, renormalize weights only.
